named_subject: a lion with a spiky mane lying down on a ledge
action: A lying lion stays still while the view pans right, the lion slides off the right edge, and a second lying lion enters from the left and settles near the middle.
identity_gap: The zigzag mane, oval face, dot eye and smile match the doodle, but the body is stretched long and low with shallow leg arches, and in frames 7-8 the face becomes a taller oval with the mane hanging down, unlike the doodle.
notes: Frames 1-6 and 10-16 hold the drawing steadily, and the pan follows the film, but at frames 7-9 the head is redrawn in a different shape, and the cut to the second lion at frame 9 shows only a head at the left with no body until frame 10. The change that would help most is to keep the doodle's head construction fixed through frames 7-8 and give the second lion its body from the frame it first appears.
